_note: Copy to ~/.config/print-studio/printer.json and edit. Read by the print-studio skill and every script. Keys you leave out fall back to this file. 'proven' holds values confirmed by your own test prints.
color_note: Design details as shape, not paint, unless the user asks for multi-colour.
_profiles_note: Bambu Studio system preset names, exactly as shown in Bambu Studio. Examples for other printers: 'Bambu Lab X1 Carbon 0.4 nozzle', 'Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle', 'Bambu Lab A1 mini 0.4 nozzle'.
_paths_note: workspace: where jobs (work/), deliverables (models/) and logs (logs/) go. python: empty = the interpreter running the scripts. bambu_studio_bin / bambu_profiles_dir: leave empty on macOS (derived from bambu_studio_app); set both on Linux/Windows. trellis_dir: only for the organic route (Apple Silicon).
